title: Virtual Compute: exit
content:
## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract. Only the customer may withdraw an application or terminate their provisioned resources. An applied contract can be withdrawn without any setup, usage or termination charge. For active or suspended contracts, record closure date from the frozen clock and stop running primary meters at the exact customer-confirmed close time. Accrued usage and actual retained-resource charges remain payable; closing never erases receivables or credits. termination fee applies to an on-demand exit under the lifecycle fee basis. If a signed commitment remains unexpired and permission to forgive an unexpired commitment on cancellation is false, invoice its recorded remaining signed commitment liability in USD as a distinct termination component, without also charging future usage against that same liability. No new usage begins after closure; existing financial corrections, collection and refunds remain possible. Repeating the same closed-resource confirmation has no further effect. Before closing, the signed termination schedule supplies remaining signed commitment liability in USD and is zero when no unbilled commitment liability remains. A positive recorded liability necessarily triggers the distinct termination charge using the disposal request as its original source reference; closure and that one invoice entry complete the event chain.

## Evidence — customer disposal

For withdraw, close, close suspended, The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using compute contract reference, customer request reference, original source reference. Those records correlate to the current action by compute contract reference, customer request reference, original source reference.

## Contract transition

The customer themselves performs the applied to closed contract transition using the authoritative evidence required for that action.

The customer themselves performs the active to closed contract transition using the authoritative evidence required for that action.

The customer themselves performs the suspended to closed contract transition using the authoritative evidence required for that action.
